newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Sinopec to issue 3-yr bonds worth $161 mln.
newsitem.headline: China's Sinopec to issue 3-yr bonds worth $161 mln.

text.p: China National Petrochemical Corp (Sinopec) will issue 1.34 billion yuan ($161.4 million) worth of three-year bonds to finance expansion projects, a securities official said on Tuesday.
The yield would be 11 percent per annum.
"The bonds will issued between February 24 and March 15," an official of China Southern Securities Co, one of the underwriters, said by telephone.
Guotai Securities Co was another underwriter.

The issue would finance key projects of Sinopec's seven subsidiaries, including Maoming Petrochemical Co in southern Guangdong province, Jinling Petrochemical Co in Nanjing in eastern Jiangsu province and Tianjin Petrochemical Co, he said.
He declined to give further details.
